steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Initializes the Android project structure with the specified app and package names.

steps.title: Configure Manifest
steps.description: Sets up the Android manifest with necessary permissions, activity declarations, and theme.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build
steps.description: Configures the app-level build.gradle file with SDK versions, dependencies, and application ID.

steps.title: Design Calculator Display
steps.description: Creates the main layout for the calculator, including the TextView for displaying input and results.

steps.title: Design Calculator Buttons - Row 1 (C, ±, %, /)
steps.description: Adds the first row of calculator buttons: Clear, Sign Change (optional, for future), Percentage (optional, for future), and Divide.

steps.title: Design Calculator Buttons - Row 2 (7, 8, 9, x)
steps.description: Adds the second row of number and operation buttons: 7, 8, 9, and Multiply.

steps.title: Design Calculator Buttons - Row 3 (4, 5, 6, -)
steps.description: Adds the third row of number and operation buttons: 4, 5, 6, and Subtract.

steps.title: Design Calculator Buttons - Row 4 (1, 2, 3, +)
steps.description: Adds the fourth row of number and operation buttons: 1, 2, 3, and Add.

steps.title: Design Calculator Buttons - Row 5 (0, ., =)
steps.description: Adds the fifth row of number, decimal, and equals buttons: 0, Decimal Point, and Equals.

steps.title: Initialize UI Elements in MainActivity
steps.description: Sets up references to the TextView and Buttons in MainActivity.java and attaches click listeners.

steps.title: Implement Number Input Logic
steps.description: Adds logic to handle number button presses, appending digits to the current input display.

steps.title: Implement Operator Input Logic
steps.description: Adds logic to handle operator button presses (+, -, *, /), storing the operator and the first operand.

steps.title: Implement Clear and Decimal Logic
steps.description: Adds logic for the Clear (C) button to reset the calculator state and for the decimal point (.) button.

steps.title: Implement Equals Logic
steps.description: Adds logic for the Equals (=) button to trigger the calculation based on stored operands and operator.

steps.title: Implement Calculation Helper Method
steps.description: Creates a private helper method to perform the actual arithmetic operations based on the operator.

steps.title: Refine Display Formatting and Error Handling
steps.description: Improves how numbers are displayed and adds basic error handling (e.g., division by zero).

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: The app is ready to be built and run on an Android device or emulator.
